name: rule canonicalization
mechanism: given a proved statement of any logical shape, destructure it by shape and emit a list of oriented equations that a single equation rewriter can apply; conjunctions split, negations and disequalities become equations to false, bare statements become equations to true
requires: a logic with equality, propositional extensionality, true/false
fails_when: a fact stated as a disjunction or existential only becomes 'fact = true'
orientation is inherited from how the author wrote the statement
